input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24 meets our preferred position in full. 24.1 gives Customer a consent-free right to assign to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets (prompt notice only). 24.2 restricts Vendor assignment, delegation and transfer by change of control to Customer's prior written consent (not unreasonably withheld) and bars assignment to a direct Customer competitor. 24.3 applies a mutual reasonable-consent standard to other assignments. 24.4 expressly denies Vendor any right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees or reduce service on Customer's change of control, and requires cooperation with a permitted successor; 13.3 carries the licence across a permitted assignment. No change-of-control trigger operates against us, so nothing to redline.
